title: Drip conversion for an Esquimalt church garden

seo.title: Sample project: Esquimalt drip conversion | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: spray heads in an Esquimalt church garden replaced with drip lines and a simple controller the volunteers can run themselves.

summary: Spray heads in shrub beds converted to drip lines for a volunteer-run garden.
scope: Spray to drip conversion in four beds
challenge: Volunteers were hand-adjusting spray heads in the shrub beds, and the spray was soaking the walkways.
approach: We converted four beds from spray heads to drip lines, so water goes to the roots instead of the paths.
We installed a simple controller and walked the volunteers through it, including how to pause watering after rain.
result: Water goes to the plants, not the paths, and volunteers can run the system.
